title: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader (video game) — What Science Actually Says #Shorts
description:
Meaning is not found in Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader (video game) — it is manufactured for it. Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader is an isometric role-playing video game  developed and published by Owlcat Games set in the Warhammer 40,000 universe. The game was released for Windows, macOS, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S on December 7, 2023.

The story Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader (video game) tells about itself is the last thing to be trusted. Leana Hafer from IGN described the game as an "ultra crunchy, 130-hour space epic with excellent writing and combat", though she criticized the presence of various software bugs. Jody Macgregor from PC Gamer praised the game's tone and atmosphere, though he disliked the combat and the game's technical issues at launch.
